title: Co-optimization for Adaptive Conformal Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2603.01719v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In regression, conformal prediction often suffers from inefficiency under heteroscedasticity and skewness due to fixed, non-adaptive interval centering. We propose CoCP, a new method that parameterizes prediction intervals by a center $m(x)$ and a radius $h(x)$, and alternates between learning $h(x)$ via smooth quantile regression on folded residuals and refining $m(x)$ using a smooth interval loss. This corrects mis-centering and drives the interval toward high-density regions. Beyond finite-sample marginal validity via split-conformal calibration, we prove that CoCP also attains asymptotic conditional coverage and optimal interval length if the base estimators are consistent. Experiments demonstrate that CoCP yields tighter intervals and achieves improved empirical conditional-coverage reliability. Code is available at https://github.com/jjoeysu/cocp.

translated_title: 自适应保形预测的协同优化
translated_abstract: 在回归问题中，由于固定且非自适应的区间居中方式，保形预测在异方差和偏斜分布下常常效率低下。我们提出了CoCP，这是一种新方法，它通过中心 $m(x)$ 和半径 $h(x)$ 对预测区间进行参数化，并在通过折叠残差上的平滑分位数回归学习 $h(x)$ 与使用平滑区间损失优化 $m(x)$ 之间交替进行。该方法修正了区间居中偏差，并将区间推向高密度区域。除了通过分裂保形校准获得有限样本边际有效性之外，我们还证明了当基础估计量一致时，CoCP 还能实现渐近条件覆盖和最优区间长度。实验表明，CoCP 产生更窄的预测区间，并提升了经验条件覆盖的可靠性。代码可在 https://github.com/jjoeysu/cocp 获取。
tldr: 提出CoCP方法，通过中心与半径的交替协同优化构建自适应保形预测区间，修正居中偏差，在保证有限样本边际有效性的同时实现更窄的区间、渐近条件覆盖和最优区间长度。
en_tdlr: CoCP co-optimizes the center and radius of conformal prediction intervals via alternating smooth quantile regression and smooth interval loss refinement, correcting mis-centering to achieve tighter intervals with asymptotic conditional coverage and optimal interval length.
